summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate's core funding to avoid cuts that would impact network infrastructure and services.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, schools would have to delay network infrastructure upgrades and reduce services to absorb costs.
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, we would have to delay vital network infrastructure upgrades. Services would have to be reduced to the absorb the additional cost of what E-Rate was funding for our school district.
